regime_context: The US thematic landscape shows a broad but non-directional rotation with Memory, HBM & Storage as the fragile leader (fading breadth, low durability) and Cybersecurity/Managed Care as strong but crowded trends. The absolute-trend gate is active, historically reducing drawdowns, but momentum ranks provide no forward-return signal. A no-view is defensible given the mixed signals.

theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: One of the few eligible themes combining a durable trend (hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar=0.83) with broad participation (breadth=0.895) and no crowding (crowding_z=0.73). As the absolute-trend gate has historically lowered volatility and drawdowns, this risk-managed trend-following lean is a conditional bet that the trend persists within the gate’s discipline—not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Financials could sell off sharply on recession fears or rate-shock, and the trend may reverse despite the gate’s drawdown control, which only softens—not eliminates—losses.
